description: Use this when the signed-in owner wants something changed on ONE specific post they've seen: different words, another photo, a colour, a price or date to fix. Give its postId and the change in the owner's own words, complete. It goes to their Suara assistant or designer, who makes the change and sends the post back to review; nothing changes or posts right away. For anything not about one post, use send_to_suara.

change.description: Exactly what the owner wants changed, in their words

name: request_post_change
title: Ask for a change to a post
